description: Header file defining the ApplicationWin32 class for Windows platform integration within the starboard namespace, including window management, event handling, and system error reporting.

classes.name: ApplicationWin32
classes.description: A class managing Windows-specific application behavior, including window creation, event processing, and system error handling.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ApplicationWin32.

methods.name: CreateWindowForWin32
methods.description: Creates a new window with specified options.

methods.name: DispatchStart
methods.description: Dispatches the start event with a timestamp.

methods.name: GetCoreWindow
methods.description: Returns the current valid core window.

methods.name: GetLocalizedString
methods.description: Retrieves localized strings by ID with fallback.

methods.name: WaitForSystemEventWithTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a system event with a timeout.

methods.name: WakeSystemEventWait
methods.description: Wakes up threads waiting for system events.

methods.name: IsStartImmediate
methods.description: Indicates if start should be immediate.

methods.name: GetNextTimedEventTargetTime
methods.description: Returns the time for the next timed event.
